intended_behavior: Extend the baseline workflow to establish a working directory for the baseline mode. Add logic to scan code within the workdir and generate embeddings using suitable embedding models, starting with OpenAI. Use the Memory class to persist these embeddings for RAG functionality. Maintain existing workflow steps and integrate the embedding generation seamlessly.

Ensure the Memory class fully supports adding, querying, peeking, getting, deleting, counting stored embeddings and related metadata. Support initialization using OpenAIEmbeddingFunction when configured. Provide interfaces usable by the baseline workflow to store and retrieve embeddings, enabling code scanning and RAG features.

Confirm proper invocation of baseline workflow when mode is baseline. Pass correct parameters and ensure workdir is set up appropriately. Preserve support for other modes and handle unsupported modes gracefully.
